description: This file is a Java source file defining an Android activity that demonstrates the use of AutoCompleteTextView with a list of countries. It initializes an AutoCompleteTextView with an ArrayAdapter containing country names and sets it up in the activity's onCreate method.

classes.name: AutoComplete1
classes.description: An Activity that showcases AutoCompleteTextView with a predefined list of countries.
